title: Hinomori Shiho — An Old Wish〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Shizuku, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hi, Shii!
Of course. Come right in.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, it's very late. Is there something on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
My band's doing another show soon...
Wanna come see us...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: As long as you purchase a ticket.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Here.
The time and date should be on the back, so be sure to take a look.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Shii!
Oh, wonderful! I'm free this day!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Have you already talked to Minori and the others about this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. We asked Minori and Kiritani at school earlier today. Oh, wait... We haven't had a chance to ask Momoi yet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: In that case, why don't I ask her for you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But...
This isn't gonna be like the idol concerts you're used to seeing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So please, try not to cause any trouble for anyone else in the crowd.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait to play today♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Especially since Shizuku, Kohane and everyone else is coming to see us today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. On top of that, we couldn't be in better shape going into this show.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, we should be able to give them something pretty good as long as we play the way we have been during practice.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Airi and I will be heading over to the live house now. I can't wait♪>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Let's go with...
<Just make sure to stick with Momoi, okay?>)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (We're playing like we really mean it today. This might be the most fun I've seen them have so far...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Alright, let's throw in one of these...!)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (More. I want to play some more.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Were you waiting for us here?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we wanted to thank you all in person.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! Doesn't this only happen to famous artists?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Our very first time running into our fans as we exit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Shizuku, I didn't realize all of you...
Wait, why are you crying?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's been like this since the beginning of your show. Your performance really struck a chord with her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
It's okay. We know.
All of you really shined on stage today. It was a fantastic show!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't you have something to say, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, your performance today was beyond incredible.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your individual sounds all joined together to form this beautiful and moving melody that filled my heart with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All I wanted to do was hear more.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (More. I want to play some more.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I... I'm so happy for you too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so wonderful how you're playing in a band with Honami, Ichika and Saki again like this. And now you're all performing on stage!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so proud of all of you.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I had a lot of fun today as well.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So thanks for coming to see us, Shizuku. You too, Momoi. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you for inviting us.
Let us know when you're doing another show, okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd love to see you play again as well!
Would that be alright, Shii?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We promise to keep practicing so that we can give you an even better performance next time.
